summary: Tested public backend APIs and live responsive UI for authentication, dashboard, orders, lifecycle guards, role logins, uploads, and approval flow. Core flows pass; brute-force protection, preflight CORS, and mobile navigation have unresolved issues.

critical.issue: After five failed password attempts, the correct password still returns 200 instead of a 429 lockout. No brute-force protection is implemented.

OPTIONS with Origin=https://pinaki-crm.preview.emergentagent.com returns 400 and no access-control-allow-origin header, despite FRONTEND_URL being configured. Simple login response also omits allow-origin.

ui_bugs.issue: The visible mobile menu button has no click handler; sidebar remains hidden, so users cannot navigate away from Dashboard on mobile.

integration_issues.issue: Clients, Design, Approvals, Production, Dispatch, Challans, Delivery, Accounts, Invoices, and Payments route only to ComingSoon placeholders. Orders new buttons also have no handler, and there is no document upload UI despite the working backend endpoint.

action_items: Add per-account/IP brute-force lockout after five failed logins and return 429.
Fix FRONTEND_URL/CORS preflight handling so the configured public origin receives allow-origin and credentials headers.
Implement mobile menu open/close state and expose sidebar navigation on small screens.
Implement the promised CRM modules and wire New order/document upload actions; currently most navigation is placeholder-only.
Apply role restrictions to lifecycle transitions, not only client/order creation.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py has no failed-login tracking or lockout logic.
server.py allows any authenticated role to PATCH any order stage; require() is not applied to lifecycle transition permissions.
App.js renders every non-Dashboard/non-Orders route through ComingSoon and leaves the mobile menu button without onClick.

success_rate.frontend: 90% (core desktop flow passed; mobile navigation failed)

seed_data_creation: No new clients or orders created. One TEST_lifecycle.txt document record was uploaded to seeded order PS-2603-3F91 for persistence testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL and credentials are documented. Core desktop login/session/dashboard/order search/detail/approval, all seeded role logins, lifecycle 409 guards, role client restriction, and GridFS document upload passed. Recheck CORS preflight, five-failure lockout, mobile menu, and module implementations after fixes.
rca of the issue: The lockout failure is structural: login only verifies bcrypt and raises 401, with no attempt counter or account/IP state. The CORS failure is reproducible at the public ingress preflight layer despite FRONTEND_URL being set, so inspect deployed middleware/ingress origin handling. Mobile failure is direct: mobile-menu-button is rendered without state or click callback while .sidebar is display:none under 650px. The approval seed was temporarily advanced during UI testing and reset before final backend regression assertions.
